title: Triage verdict
description: findings/<finding_id>/triage.json — the last gate before anything reaches the user. gate_triage_pass.py denies a PASS written here unless the sibling verify.json says CONFIRMED.

verdict.description: PASS = ready for the user to review and submit. BLOCK = a specific gap must close first. DOWNGRADE = real but lower than claimed. REJECT = should not be filed.

conceded_privilege_check.description: Run every time, no exceptions. Is the 'vulnerability' actually a privilege the program has already conceded? This is the single most common reason a report comes back Informative. See memory/general-lessons.md lessons 1 and 2, and the target's own corpus under memory/closed-reports/<target>/.

cvss_vector.description: CVSS 3.1. C/I/A take None/Low/High only — there is no Medium.

inflation_check.description: Metrics considered for a higher value and rejected, with the spec reason. Pick the defensible score, not the most dramatic one that technically fits.

blocking_gaps.description: Required when verdict is BLOCK. What specifically must close, in actionable terms.

duplicate_risk.description: No public-source check can see another researcher's pending private report. Weight higher for well-known bug-class shapes in heavily-hunted modules.

calibration_checked.description: Which memory/general-lessons.md lessons (always applicable) and which memory/closed-reports/<target>/ entries were read. An empty target corpus is expected on a new target; the general lessons are still required.
